data.name: Aroobah
data.gender_notes: Aroobah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic root 'r-b-b', which means to sustain or maintain. In Islamic tradition, the name Aroobah is given to a girl who is believed to be a source of support, strength, and nourishment for her family and community. The name Aroobah carries the meaning “The one who sustains” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aroobah usually hope their child will grow to embody the one who sustains and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of Allah's sustenance and provision

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aroobah total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
